build_linformer_model: build a LinformerModel instance using build_model with args and task for linear complexity self-attention
build_linformer_encoder: build a LinformerEncoder with args and dictionary to create a LinformerTransformerEncoder with BERT param initialization
add_linformer_args: add Linformer-specific CLI arguments like compressed ratio and shared KV compression to an argparse parser
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade a LinformerEncoder state dict to fix old checkpoint weight sharing and re-init the LM head
configure_base_architecture: configure the base linformer_roberta architecture with compressed ratio and freeze compress settings
